title: Routine ICU Surveillance after Brain Tumor Surgery: Patient Selection Using Machine Learning
summary: XGBoost predicted early adverse events after brain-tumor surgery in a retrospective cohort of 1,000 patients; preoperative-only cross-validated ROC-AUC was 0.76 and combined pre/postoperative AUC 0.81. The outcome is a specific patient-selection question, with retrospective single-center validation limits.
ai_technology: XGBoost gradient boosting on 27 perioperative features; retrospective 1,000 consecutive adult tumor resections. Repeated 5×5 CV; nine adverse-event/intervention outcomes within 24 hours; pre-op-only AUC 0.76, combined pre/post-op AUC 0.81.
